allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.

facts.title: The Dead Zone

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Waking into a life stolen by time is shock enough, but what happens when a single touch reveals horrific fates you might be able to prevent?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After a devastating car crash puts schoolteacher Johnny Smith in a five-year coma, he awakens to discover an unsettling new power: physical contact lets him see the past, present, and future of anyone he touches.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Somber, suspenseful sci-fi drama paced with deliberate tension and heavy emotional stakes, ideal for focused late-night viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: David Cronenberg directs this thoughtful supernatural thriller, grounding high-concept psychic visions in profound personal loss and escalating suspense.

claudeAdvisory.claimSpan: a single touch reveals horrific fates you might be able to prevent
issueSummaries: curiosityHook says the touch reveals 'horrific fates you might be able to prevent'. The overview says only that Johnny can see into the past, present and future life of anyone he touches. It does not say the visions are horrific, that they concern fates or deaths, or that he can prevent anything. 'Might be able to prevent' adds an agency and intervention mechanic that the packet does not state, and it frames the premise around a specific plot direction the overview leaves open.
claudeAdvisory.sourceBoundaryReason: Nearly all of the copy is grounded or is tolerated figurative language and genre shorthand under A_PRIME_PRODUCTION_MATERIALITY_V1 ('unsettling', 'profound personal loss', 'escalating suspense', 'stolen by time'). The exception is one clause in curiosityHook that gives the visions a dark content ('horrific fates') and gives Johnny the possibility of intervening ('might be able to prevent'). That falsely specifies plot mechanics and the story's direction, which are named materiality categories, and it edges toward what the film's central conflict is. It does not contradict the source, invent identities, or reveal an outcome, and the hedged 'might' keeps it from asserting anything, so the severity is MINOR and not SEVERE. A bounded fix would stay with the overview, for example 'what happens when a single touch reveals the past, present and future of anyone he meets?'.

sourceEvidence.notes: curiosityHook: 'horrific fates' and 'might be able to prevent' have no support. The overview describes visions of the past, present and future life of anyone touched, with no mention of harm, death, or the ability to change what is seen. 'Waking into a life stolen by time' is a figurative gloss on waking from a five-year coma and is tolerated. 'A single touch' is a light paraphrase of 'physical contact'.

description: schoolteacher Johnny Smith, the car crash, the five-year coma, waking to a new ability, and the past, present and future vision by physical contact all restate the overview. 'Devastating' intensifies the crash. 'Unsettling new power' is a tonal gloss on 'ability'. 'Anyone he touches' paraphrases 'anyone with whom he comes into physical contact'. The description omits the fiancée and the night of the crash, which is an emphasis choice.

whyWatch and vibeSummary: 'supernatural thriller', 'sci-fi drama' and 'psychic visions' are consistent with genres Horror/Science Fiction/Thriller and the overview's ability. 'Psychic' also appears in facts.keywords. 'David Cronenberg' matches director. 'Profound personal loss' follows from the overview's stolen years and the 'whole life ahead of him' framing. 'Escalating suspense' is tonal shorthand.

acceptedSemanticClassification: 'Somber' and 'heavy emotional stakes' match emotionalWeight=heavy. 'Suspenseful' and 'thoughtful' match moods. 'Deliberate tension' matches pace=medium. 'Focused... viewing' matches attentionDemand=engaged and situations=[alone]. 'Late-night' is a viewing-mood flourish. Keyword-only material (series of murders, sheriff, sacrifice, madness) is not imported.

claudeAdvisory.uncertaintyNotes: This is a near-threshold call. A suspenseful horror and thriller premise makes 'horrific' a plausible tonal gloss, and 'prevent' is a natural reading of foreseeing the future, so an adjudicator could approve on that basis. I flag the clause because the packet gives the visions no content beyond time scope, and prevention is a specific plot direction. 'Devastating' for the crash and 'unsettling' for the power were considered and left within tolerance. 'Whole life ahead of him' is omitted from the copy, which is an emphasis choice.

geminiAdvisory.sourceBoundaryReason: 所有可见文案均严格符合 A_PRIME_PRODUCTION_MATERIALITY_V1 标准。description 对授权概览中的车祸、五年昏迷以及触碰预知能力进行了忠实且克制的同义转述；whyWatch 与 vibeSummary 准确锚定已验证的基准元数据与情绪/体验标签。curiosityHook 中的修辞性提问（“horrific fates you might be able to prevent”）属于基于恐怖/惊悚类型及通灵预知前提下的合理戏剧化修辞与悬念营造，未实质性断言未授权的硬性剧情机制，亦未泄露外部原著小说设定或第三幕剧透。

sourceEvidence.notes: 直接支持主角 Johnny Smith 因车祸陷入长达 5 年的昏迷，醒来后发现通过肢体接触能洞悉他人过去、现在与未来人生的核心设定。
直接确认恐怖（Horror）、科幻（Science Fiction）与惊悚（Thriller）类型，为文案中的“supernatural thriller”与“sci-fi drama”提供依据。

facts.director 验证导演为 David Cronenberg；acceptedSemanticClassification 充分支撑了情感沉重（heavy / 'profound personal loss' / 'heavy emotional stakes'）、节奏适中（medium / 'deliberate tension'）、专注度高（engaged / 'focused'）与独处观看（alone / 'late-night viewing'）的体验定位。

geminiAdvisory.uncertaintyNotes: curiosityHook 提及“horrific fates you might be able to prevent”，在 A_PRIME_PRODUCTION_MATERIALITY_V1 标准下，该反问式引导属于典型的低风险类型化修辞与戏剧性紧迫感表达，未构成实质性误导观众预期的事实违规。
